nodes.label: ASS subtitle burn-in via libass
nodes.rationale: Chosen over drawtext: enough for all subtitle effects, text known in advance, uses DirectWrite and avoids fontconfig errors; appended at end of existing re-encoding filter_complex in _apply_story_overlays so no extra pass.

nodes.label: Font registry (scan_fonts, family-name resolution)
nodes.rationale: libass resolves fonts by family name via DirectWrite so fontsdir is not needed for system fonts; per-glyph fallback mixes Malgun Gothic and Arial for KR+VI text.

nodes.label: Max-chars-per-frame re-segmentation (strategy A)
nodes.rationale: Manual \N wrapping with WrapStyle 2 is deterministic vs font-metric-dependent auto wrap; durations split proportional to character count; Korean/CJK counted by grapheme not spaces.

nodes.label: Subtitle preview render (hash-cached)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors generate_tv_effect_style_preview (720p, 3-5s, loop); defaults to libx264 CPU to avoid NVENC contention with running batches.

nodes.label: <audio>.chapters.txt chapter file
nodes.rationale: Lines 'time | title | label | quote', '>' lines are emphasis quotes; timestamps snap to nearest subtitle line; without file, chapters auto-split from SRT but no chapter text is shown.

nodes.label: EditPlan runtime (src/utils/edit_styles)
nodes.rationale: Modules spec, store, graph (Ops(gpu) emits GPU or CPU filters for one graph), assets, chapters, runtime, preview; pipeline hooks EditPlan at clip choice, ASS build, extra inputs, filter segments, waveform/CTA placement.

nodes.label: GPU overlay without subtitles outputs 1920x1088
nodes.rationale: Known pre-existing bug in _gpu_overlay_tail scale_cuda branch: 8 green rows at bottom; subtitle branch (hwdownload + ASS) is correct 1080.

nodes.label: Ken Burns baked in library bake
nodes.norm_label: ken burns baked in library bake
nodes.rationale: Render-time Ken Burns was too slow (3.1x); baking adds under 1 s per clip and is stored in library metadata.

nodes.label: Layouts (bo cuc, one per video)
nodes.rationale: plain, tv_frame, tv_glass, tv_drift, card, letterbox, film_frame, osd_camcorder, osd_cctv, drift, magazine, split_accent, dossier, newsroom, album, doc_strip, tv_zoom, two_layer. Frame-shrinking layouts are blocked with libraries that have baked waveform/CTA; decor layouts require at least one decor image.

nodes.label: Light effects (light_sweep, light_leak, light_rays, spotlight)
nodes.rationale: Each effect is one cached pre-rendered PNG plus eval=frame x/y expressions with enable gating; costs 0-14% overlay time each.

nodes.label: Modifiers (hieu ung bo tro)
nodes.rationale: cut_accents, long_takes, voice_bars, cta_moments, chapter_cards, quote_moments, light effects; stacked over the layout; at most one instance per kind per video.

nodes.label: 'Moi clip 1 lan' clip-usage mode
nodes.rationale: Unused clips first then least-used; usage counted only after successful render; returns 503 when MongoDB is off instead of silently falling back to random picks.

nodes.label: Library Bake (pre-baked TV effect)
nodes.rationale: Baked libraries skip the TV-effect step at render; fully baked libraries contain waveform/CTA so backend refuses to combine them with decor.

nodes.label: Library Normalize (canon format)
nodes.rationale: Normalizing resolution/fps/pix_fmt/color up front avoids piecemeal re-encodes at render; clips not matching CLIP_EXPECTED_* are dropped at render.

nodes.label: Optional MongoDB (story_video_studio DB)
nodes.rationale: Collections source_videos, clips, clip_usage_events, search_keywords; empty MONGODB_URI disables it entirely so default flow needs no DB.

nodes.label: Pexels API key pool rotation
nodes.rationale: Quota is per key (200 req/h, 20k/month); PEXELS_API_KEY_2, _3... extend the pool and exhausted keys rest.

nodes.label: story_overlays CPU bottleneck (~88% of time)
nodes.rationale: With OVERLAY_USE_GPU_PIPELINE=false the overlay pass runs on CPU while GPU/NVENC idle; recommendation: move overlay to GPU (overlay_cuda) or render sequentially.

nodes.label: Edit Styles (kieu dung) integration plan
nodes.rationale: Videos in a batch previously shared one layout; edit styles rotate per video so videos in the same batch differ. Delivered in 4 phases (2026-09-22 to 2026-09-28).

nodes.label: Story Video Studio
nodes.rationale: Combines one audio (or Google Docs link via TTS) with a 5s clip library into YouTube/TikTok video; React+Vite frontend, Flask+FFmpeg backend; only two pages /story-video and /story-video/settings.

nodes.label: Render benchmark report (10-min audio, GTX 1060)
nodes.rationale: 1 video 550.8s (1.09x RTF); 2 in parallel 1053.6s (1.14x), only ~4% faster than sequential due to CPU contention.

nodes.label: Relative .ass path convention
nodes.rationale: FFmpeg filter parser treats ':' as option separator so drive-letter absolute paths break parsing; always pass paths relative to ffmpeg cwd.

nodes.label: Pexels Authorization header auth
nodes.rationale: Key in URL is rejected with 401; must be sent only in the Authorization header.

nodes.label: Pixabay 24h caching + attribution ToS
nodes.rationale: Terms require caching API data/assets at least 24h and linking back via pageURL when displayed.

nodes.label: Pixabay key query-param auth
nodes.rationale: Header auth is unsupported (401/403); key must be passed as ?key=.

nodes.label: ASS cost-by-area rule (split drawings, single-frame PNG + eof_action=repeat)
nodes.norm_label: ass cost-by-area rule (split drawings, single-frame png + eof_action=repeat)
nodes.rationale: libass cost scales with drawn area, so ASS drawings are split into small pieces and timed toggles use one-frame PNG overlays.

nodes.label: Balanced-tree FFmpeg expression summation
nodes.rationale: Flat sum chains fail to parse beyond ~110 clauses while a 10-minute video has ~200 cut points.

nodes.label: Filter graph passed via -/filter_complex file
nodes.rationale: Avoids the 32K-character Windows command-line limit.

nodes.label: Minimum 11x realtime speed rule
nodes.rationale: Styles below 11x were dropped: render-time Ken Burns (3.1x) and ambilight (10.5x). All 24 shipped styles measured 11.3x-18.4x on 10-minute audio.
